Let me try a completely different approach. Maybe the game has a "read notice" that requires facing the notice board from an adjacent tile. The notice board is at (2,7). To face it, I'd stand at (2,8) facing up, or (1,7) facing right, etc. But I can't move to those tiles.

This is circular. Let me reconsider whether I'm actually stuck or whether the movement is just very slow / requires a different input. Let me check body_controls once more and try pressing the movement as "press" instead of "hold".
